title: X Matrix Validation
description: A square matrix is an X matrix when every cell on either main diagonal is non-zero and every other cell is zero. For odd sizes, the center belongs to both diagonals. Given a square integer matrix `grid`, return whether it is an X matrix. Input: `grid`. Output: true or false.
hints: Check each cell using its row and column relationships.
Handle single-row, single-column, tie, and center-cell cases explicitly.
